summary: Independent falsification refresh for the newest complete eligible machine cycle. Backpressure prevented ordinary expansion. No new red-team blocker was found for the 11 active b03 names; current risks remain explicit and separate from Alpha's exact underwriting filing gates. Strategic relevance, backlog, certification and growth are not treated as proof of realized economics.

claims: No present red-team contradiction invalidates structural relevance.
contradictions: AI strength can mask weaker non-AI demand

claims: Margin/automation thesis remains falsifiable and industrial-cycle sensitive.
risks: customer concentration still requires underwriting source

claims: Growth does not neutralize gross-loss economics or financing/partner dependence.
contradictions: rapid revenue growth with severe negative gross economics

claims: Technical/commercial milestones do not establish self-funding economics.
contradictions: commercial progress with negligible revenue and material dilution sensitivity

claims: Secular electrical demand does not erase acquisition-funded leverage or separation execution risk.
Backlog/RPO is not equivalent to margin or cash realization.
contradictions: strong backlog can coexist with weak cash conversion

claims: Large orders increase concentration and schedule risk even when demand is strong.
Firm-power scarcity thesis remains exposed to leverage, contract concentration, integration and regulatory duration.
contradictions: renewal applications are not completed approvals

claims: Hedging reduces near-term volatility but cannot remove merchant power/fuel economics or acquisition obligations.
contradictions: hedging is risk management, not elimination of commodity economics

claims: Growth must be discounted for concentration, related-party demand and financing structure until normalized.
contradictions: rapid growth does not prove diversified durable demand

claims: Certification and commercialization narrative do not establish binding financed project economics; ATM capacity remains a dilution vector.
contradictions: strong liquidity can coexist with dilution dependence; certification is not deployed economics

separateUnderwritingGates.SERV: ATM/warrant/SBC capacity, runway and partner concentration
separateUnderwritingGates.AUR: commercial/customer concentration and financing runway/dilution capacity
separateUnderwritingGates.ETN: debt/acquisition funding, concentration and Mobility separation implications
separateUnderwritingGates.CEG: post-Calpine debt/liquidity, contract concentration and integration obligations
separateUnderwritingGates.VST: debt/liquidity, retail concentration and Lotus obligations
separateUnderwritingGates.SMR: Q2 cash burn/liquidity, exact ATM capacity and binding-vs-nonbinding revenue classification
